purpose: Compare the custom point-in-time EDINET extractor with edinet-tools on identical source ZIP bytes before using any parser difference in research.

source_policy.availability_source: Existing custom EDINET submit_datetime/available_at contract remains authoritative.
source_policy.parser_disagreement_rule: Fail closed for research admission. Never choose whichever parser value improves strategy performance.

field_pairs.shares_outstanding: edinet-tools raw_facts under the frozen issued-share element/context priority

issued_share_policy.ambiguity: Multiple conflicting values at the same frozen priority are unknown/ambiguous.
issued_share_policy.reason: Real EDINET filings commonly place fiscal-year-end issued-share facts at FilingDateInstant, while the prior custom generic context filter accepted only CurrentYear.

real_historical_sample_v1.selection_inputs: EDINET document metadata only; parser outputs, accounting values, strategy candidates, scores, returns, labels and 2026 market outcomes are forbidden selection inputs.
real_historical_sample_v1.deterministic_rule: Within each calendar quarter and eligible doc_type_code, sort eligible metadata rows by submit_datetime ascending then doc_id ascending and select the first 2 unique doc_id values. Do not replace a selected document because either parser fails or disagrees.
real_historical_sample_v1.deduplication: doc_id exact; retain the first metadata row after deterministic sort.
real_historical_sample_v1.corrections: Doc type 130 is sampled independently rather than replacing its related 120 filing.
real_historical_sample_v1.minimum_execution_requirement: Execute only if the metadata source covers the full preregistered 2023-01-01 through 2025-12-31 interval; otherwise fail closed and record the coverage gap without changing the sample rule.
forbidden_output_fields: promotion decision based on strategy outcome
real_historical_sample_v1.disagreement_policy: Every mismatch or one-sided missing value is an audit finding. Neither implementation becomes authoritative merely because it agrees with a backtest or produces more favorable research results.
real_historical_sample_v1.post_execution_rule: Freeze the selected doc_id list and source ZIP hashes before reviewing aggregate mismatch rates. Any parser correction discovered from the sample must be semantic/source-grounded and regression-tested; the same frozen sample is then rerun without resampling.
